details:
In Public instances, the Vote Kick system is completely anonymous. This is being actively abused.

Malicious users repeatedly open vote kicks against a single target, even when that user is not breaking any rules. Because kicks keep popping up, other players in the instance start to perceive the target as a problematic user, even though their actual behavior is normal.

This is being used for:

Reputation manipulation: Creating a false impression that someone is a troll/griefer.

Instigation / Agitation: Causing confusion and arguments in the instance ("Why is this person getting kicked again?").

Targeted harassment & Sniping: A group of users can coordinate to repeatedly kick-vote a specific user to isolate them or force them to leave.

Proposal:

Please make the initiator of a vote kick transparent.

Show a system message: e.g., " initiated a vote kick against "

Or, at minimum, log the initiator's user ID in the Group Instance Moderation log for Group Public owners to review.

This small transparency change would drastically reduce abuse, as malicious users would be held accountable for opening false kicks. Currently, there is no way to report the abuser because we don't know who started it.
title: Make Vote Kick initiator public to prevent reputation manipulation and targeted harassment in Public worlds
